newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy falls further on fund selling, technicals.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy falls further on fund selling, technicals.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures fell further early on aggressive fund selling as technical sell stops were hit, traders said.

New crop November soy found initial selling on its break below key support at $8.00 per bushel in overnight dealings and further sell-stops were triggered at the $7.91 level in early dealings Monday, they said.
Refco Inc sold two million bushels of November, LIT America sold three million November and SAK Trading sold one million November, traders said.
Volatile weather patterns stirred long liquidation.

Friday's Commodity Futures Trading Commission Commitments of Traders report showed non-commercial longs in soybeans as of September 10 at almost 10 to one, leaving open the possiblity for a wave of fund long liquidation, the traders said.
At 1015 CDT, soybeans were seven to 15-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with November down 13 in fast trading at $7.89 a bushel.
